title: rag.py eval scores an expect_re regex column and runs the held-out reword and off-kb checks on repro_bench.csv
goal: rag.py eval reads an optional expect_re column of regexes separated by `;`, matched with re.search and no flags over the pack text as agent_bench scores answers; it fails a row none of whose regexes matches with the failure token regex; eval --file on a file whose name is in a new rag.FROZEN_FILES tuple of lookup_heldout.csv and repro_bench.csv runs the held-out reword check against the lookup_eval.csv beside it, with rag.HELDOUT_FILE kept for its other readers and the sync gate's eval sets unchanged; kb/_self/tools.md's eval row names expect_re and repro_bench.csv; kb/_self/maintaining.md's held-out exception covers repro_bench.csv; no new test id: test_live_kb.py's test_lookup_eval_fails_on_a_wrong_expected_article gains a planted expect_re row and the reword test gains the second file name.

run:
import csv,json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); f=os.path.join(d,'t.csv')
with open(f,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as h:
    w=csv.writer(h); w.writerow(['id','question','expect_paths','expect_verdict','allow_weak','expect_text','expect_re'])
    q='JEA role capability file and session configuration to restart a service'
    w.writerow(['RE-1',q,'','good','yes','','Just Enough|JEA']); w.writerow(['RE-2',q,'','good','yes','','zzzz[0-9]{9}'])
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','--json','eval','--file',f,'--root','public','--all'],capture_output=True,text=True)
rows={r['id']:r for r in json.loads(p.stdout)['rows']}
ok=p.returncode==1 and rows['RE-1']['ok'] and not rows['RE-2']['ok'] and 'regex' in rows['RE-2']['failed']
print(p.returncode,{k:v['failed'] for k,v in rows.items()}); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import csv,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); shutil.copy('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv',d)
r=next(csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv',encoding='utf-8')))
f=os.path.join(d,'repro_bench.csv')
with open(f,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as h:
    w=csv.writer(h); w.writerow(['id','question','expect_paths','expect_verdict','allow_weak']); w.writerow(['RB-1',r['question']+' please',r['expect_paths'],r['expect_verdict'],r['allow_weak']])
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','eval','--file',f,'--root','public','--all'],capture_output=True,text=True)
out=p.stdout+p.stderr; print(p.returncode,out[:300]); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==1 and 'REWORD RB-1' in out else 1)

import sys
row=[l for l in open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8') if l.startswith('| `python3 _tools/rag.py src')]
ok=len(row)==1 and 'expect_re' in row[0] and 'repro_bench.csv' in row[0]
print(len(row),ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys
row=[l for l in open('kb/_self/maintaining.md',encoding='utf-8') if l.startswith('  - the exception: a failing row of the held-out file')]
ok=len(row)==1 and 'repro_bench.csv' in row[0]
print(len(row),ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
